params.name: includeArchived
params.description: Include soft-archived categories. Defaults to true.

items.docs: Return the controlled taxonomy used for strict-products governance. Includes archived categories by default so dashboards can render historical tags.
Create a new product category. `key` must be unique per business and is immutable once created — downstream reporting rolls up by key.
Update the name, description, GL code, or revenue class of a product category. The `key` is immutable — create a new category if the taxonomy needs to split.

Soft-archive the category. Archived categories cannot be attached to new pricing plans but stay linked to historical ones so reporting is stable. To restore, PATCH `archivedAt` back to null via the un-archive endpoint is NOT exposed — recreate a new category or use PATCH if un-archive support is added later.
